Figure with figcaption preserves both image and caption

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<figure><img src=\"sunset.jpg\" alt=\"A sunset\"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset over the ocean</figcaption></figure>")
IO.inspect(result)
```
